metadata.case_name: NG KAR YIU v. CHENG CHUNG LOK AND OTHERS

injuries.description: His right arm was amputated just below the elbow.
source: His right arm was amputated just below the elbow.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation at level between right elbow and wrist

injuries.description: The Plaintiff suffered a crush injury and multiple laceration of the left hand.
source: The Plaintiff suffered a crush injury and multiple laceration of the left hand.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple sites of hand

injuries.description: The left radius and ulna were each fractured.
source: The left radius and ulna were each fractured.

manifestations.description: Good range of movement in the thumb, which can be opposed to the middle, third and fourth fingers.
Those fingers will not fully close to make a fist resulting in poor grip.
The index finger is effectively frozen at a right angle at the middle joint and deviates towards the little finger.
Cannot use chopsticks but can manage a spoon or fork.

treatments_received: Occupational therapy assessment by Alice Tsang
treatments_future: Further surgery to left hand recommended
Myoelectric prosthesis to be provided/replaced (recommended initially two devices)

losses.description: Amputation of right arm below the right elbow.
Damage and permanent defects to left hand with reduced grip; index finger frozen at middle joint and deviation towards little finger; cannot use chopsticks (can use spoon or fork).
